data.name: ReasonOutputDestroyed

data.comment: Tooltip line on the PI tool's status chip. {0} is a date and time (estimated).

data.name: ReasonRawOverflow
data.value: Raw material will overflow storage from {0}: extraction outpaces the factories.
data.comment: Tooltip line on the PI tool's status chip. {0} is a date and time (estimated).

data.name: ColImports
data.comment: PI tool, Colonies tab, column header: the items a colony needs brought in from off the planet.

data.name: ColExports
data.comment: PI tool, Colonies tab, column header: the items a colony makes to be taken off the planet — its end products, not what one factory makes for the next.

data.name: ColWaitingVolume
data.comment: PI tool, Colonies tab, column header: the m³ of exports in storage now, waiting to be picked up.

data.name: ColWaitingValue
data.comment: PI tool, Colonies tab, column header: the market value of exports in storage now, waiting to be picked up.

data.name: TipImports
data.value: Brought in from off the planet, a day:
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool, Imports column: its first line. A line per item follows (TypePerDay).

data.name: TipNoImports
data.value: Nothing is brought in: everything this colony's factories use is made on the planet.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool, Imports column, for a colony that needs nothing brought in.

data.name: TipExports
data.value: Taken off the planet, a day. Only what nothing on the planet uses — what one factory makes for the next is not listed:
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool, Exports column: its first line. A line per item follows (TypePerDay).

data.name: TipNoExports
data.value: Nothing is left over to take off the planet.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool, Exports column, for a colony with nothing to take off.

data.name: TypePerDay
data.comment: PI tool, a line of the Imports or Exports tooltip. {0} is an item name, {1} the units a day.

data.name: VolumeM3
data.comment: PI tool: a volume. {0} is the number of cubic metres.

data.name: TipWaiting
data.value: Exports in storage now, waiting to be picked up — an estimate, replayed from the colony's last visit in the game ({0}):
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool, Waiting columns: its first line. {0} is a date and time. A line per item follows (WaitingLine).

data.name: TipNoWaiting
data.value: No exports in storage now — an estimate, replayed from the colony's last visit in the game ({0}).
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool, Waiting columns, when nothing is waiting. {0} is a date and time.

data.name: WaitingLine
data.comment: PI tool, a line of the Waiting tooltip. {0} is the number of units, {1} an item name, {2} cubic metres, {3} an ISK amount.

data.name: SummaryWaiting
data.value: {0} m³ of exports waiting, worth {1} ISK
data.comment: PI tool summary line, last part. {0} is cubic metres, {1} an ISK amount.
